crossRefs.note: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
translations.bsb: Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
translations.kjv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
translations.asv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years. And he gave up the ghost and died, and was gathered unto his people.
